function: Over-the-air FL aggregation (AirComp power control) over a single-antenna MAC without RIS; p. 4: "K signal antenna edge devices and one signal antenna base station (BS)"
notes: Excluded at code 6 (system). Codes 1-5 pass: research article proposing PAOTA; FL over the air counts as learned; the problem is the over-the-air aggregation, p. 3: "asynchronous FEEL system via analog AirComp", so area 7. Every node has one antenna and there is no RIS: p. 4: "K signal antenna edge devices and one signal antenna base station (BS)" ("signal" is the paper's typo for single); the channel is a scalar, p. 4: "is the complex channel coefficient of the uplink transmission between client k and the PS"; p. 9: "the uplink channels follow the i.i.d. Rayleigh fading". Not OTFS or NTN, so the single-antenna exception does not apply. Page 1 holds the title and DOI 10.1109/TVT.2024.3466556, matching the PDF.
